items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-26
items.q: He played with me once or twice.

ctx.x: Handy. That's correct. That's where they kept the account. The original name was from Memphis, Tennessee. It was called Pace and Handy, the original friend. Now, this Negro recorded. After Ralph Pell. I think this man runs a southern music company today, if I'm not mistaken. After our big success on Broadway and rising, that was January the 15th, which we opened there. And the sensation we created was something that they had never heard of in 50 years on Broadway. Anyway, the Columbia company, trying to get…
Now, Mr. LaRocco, I want to tell you that we made some tapes Saturday night of Raymond Burke, who used to work with you. You remember?
He didn't work with me. Didn't work with you? No. He played with me once or twice. Yes. I know Larry Burke. You know who Larry Burke is? He's Jules Kazard's nephew. Yes.
